Upload**≠**[File](/vibe-hub/file?lang=en)

[Upload](/vibe-hub/upload?lang=en) handles choosing, transferring, and retrying a file. [File](/vibe-hub/file?lang=en) displays a file that already exists or is being processed.

Video URL⬆ Upload
